title: The Best 4K RGB LED TVs to Buy In 2026: Here’s Where to Shop Online
summary: From Sony to LG, Shop Billboard rounded up the best 4K TVs for watching live music performances and live sports.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In 2026, the next generation of TV display is 4K Micro RGB and RGB Mini-LED (Red, Green and Blue). With these new displays, picture quality is bolder and more color accurate with much better visibility and viewing angles than TV models from past years. The TVs have high levels of sharpness and detail to get the most out of your favorite movies, TV shows, music programming and live sports.

Shop Billboard rounded up the latest 4K RGB LED TVs from top manufacturers, like Sony , Samsung, Hisense and others. Meanwhile, all of the 4K TVs listed below feature built-in streaming for popular video and music apps, including Netflix, HBO Max, Prime Video, Apple TV and Apple Music, Hulu, Disney+, YouTube and Spotify.

Shop 4K RGB LED TVs at Best Buy

If you’re serious about your home entertainment, then consider upgrading this year.

TRUE RGB

Sony 75-Inch BRAVIA 7 II True RGB 4K TV

Editor’s Choice

$3,099.99

Buy Now at Best Buy

Starting at $1,599.99 at Best Buy, the Sony BRAVIA 7 II 4K TV features the company’s “True RGB” technology for advanced picture quality with brighter and more vibrant colors and deeper and richer black levels. At up to 85 inches in size (a 98-inch model is coming soon), it produces more accurate color contrast that pops when watching your favorite movies and TV shows.

In addition, the 4K TV is best for rooms that get direct sunlight. Usually, the sun would cut through picture quality and dull images, but with this Sony TV, the contrast on screen remains crisp and clear in daylight.

FLAGSHIP MODEL

Sony 75-Inch BRAVIA 9 II True RGB 4K TV

Best for Live Sports

$6,499.99

The Sony 75-Inch BRAVIA 9 II True RGB 4K TV is ideal for gaming, especially with a PlayStation 5 since Sony makes both the 4K TV and console. It’s also great for watching live sports with more immersive picture quality with active color and action shifts for high-paced motion.

GOOGLE TV

Hisense 85-Inch UR8 RGB MiniLED Series 4K TV

Best for IMAX

$2,499.99 $3,499.99 29% off

At up to 100 inches in size, the Hisense 85-Inch UR8 RGB MiniLED Series 4K TV has IMAX Enhanced support for watching movies in a massive way. It’s certified for IMAX picture performance with DTS immersive audio for a complete cinematic experience in your living room. It’s the closest to having an IMAX theater in your home instead of going to your local movie theater.

COMPLETE HDR

TCL 115-Inch Class RM9L RGB-Mini LED 4K TV

Best for Size

$24,999.99

The TCL Class RM9L RGB-Mini LED 4K TV features the largest display in this article with models clocking in upward of a whopping 115 inches in size. That’s more than nine-and-a-half feet from corner-to-corner of pure RGB 4K picture quality. The new display features peak brightness, local dimming and a wide color gamut that promises a gigantic cinema experience from home. This is the best choice for those who know they’ll be streaming blockbusters from home, as well as live sports, in a big way.

SAMSUNG SMARTTHINGS

Samsung 85-Inch R95H Micro RGB 4K TV

Best for Performance

With prices capped at $6,499.99 for the 85-inch model, the Samsung R95H Micro RGB 4K TV is a massive Ultra HD TV that features “Micro RGB” technology for richer and more vibrant color accuracy, as well as deeper and darker black levels for a better picture contrast — compared to previous models. It has a 165Hz refresh rate (with variable refresh rate support that adapts to what you’re watching) for buttery smooth motion when watching action movies and live sports. The 4K TV has Samsung’s “Motion Xcelerator” tech for picture stability and seamless performance with just about anything on the display. It’s even Amazon Alexa and Samsung SmartThings for voice search and hands-free navigation.

WEBOS TV

LG 86-Inch 95B Micro RGB LED 4K TV

Best for Color Processing

$6,499.99 $6,999.99 7% off

On sale for $6,499.99 (was $6,999.99) at Best Buy, the LG 86-Inch 95B Micro RGB LED 4K TV features enhanced 4K video and audio powered by LG’s Alpha 11 AI Processor with Micro RGB Engine built-in. This means picture quality is vibrant, vivid and bright, while it uses AI to adjust image smoothness and motion on-the-fly. It runs LG’s webOS 26 for streaming access to Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, HBO Max, Apple TV, Peacock, Paramount+, Spotify and other services.
